# An existing non-repository has a project error without raw Git stderr.
mkdir $WORK/not-a-worktree
assert-exit 65 zwm --project $WORK/not-a-worktree wco feature/ready
stderr '^zwm: project: project .+ is not a Git worktree\n$'
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG want-log

-- want-log --
{"sequence":1,"command":"git","args":["rev-parse","--show-toplevel"],"cwd":"$WORK/not-a-worktree"}
